question: How often must a healthcare facility's Quality and Patient Safety Program be formally approved and reviewed by its designated Governance Body?
anchor_quote: The Healthcare Facility Quality and Patient Safety Program shall be formally approved and reviewed by the designated Governance Body

question: How frequently must healthcare facility performance data be submitted to the Governance Body?
anchor_quote: Healthcare facility performance data shall be submitted to the Governance Body on a quarterly basis

question: How often must a patient safety culture survey be conducted at healthcare facilities licensed by the Department of Health?
anchor_quote: patient safety culture survey shall be conducted every 18 months to assess progress and inform action.

question: Which patient safety goals must healthcare facilities implement and monitor under the Department of Health Quality and Patient Safety policy?
anchor_quote: The healthcare facility shall implement a rigorous policy and structured framework to achieve patient safety goals

question: What information security measures must a healthcare facility licensed by the Department of Health have in place?
anchor_quote: The healthcare facility shall ensure robust information security measures are in place, including but not limited to, access control, encryption, audit trails

question: Which quality and patient safety programs must healthcare facilities licensed by the Department of Health implement?
Does compliance with the Department of Health Quality and Patient Safety policy end once a facility obtains accreditation or certification?
anchor_quote: Facilities must continuously meet and maintain the standards set forth by the DoH and other relevant regulatory bodies.

question: Which stakeholders are covered by the Department of Health Quality and Patient Safety policy in Abu Dhabi?
anchor_quote: This policy applies to all stakeholders within the Abu Dhabi healthcare ecosystem, including but not limited to healthcare providers, healthcare professionals

question: Under what circumstances can the Department of Health impose sanctions on healthcare facilities?
anchor_quote: DoH can impose sanctions in relation to any breach of requirements under this Policy in accordance with the disciplinary regulation of the Healthcare sector.

question: How does the Department of Health monitor compliance with and evaluate the effectiveness of its Quality and Patient Safety policy?
anchor_quote: A monitoring and evaluation plan will be implemented to ensure compliance and evaluate the effectiveness of this policy and its components.
